generation_tool: Built-in imagegen; original generated files preserved without alteration.
scope: Clothing-only authoring candidate. Original wearer pixels are copied unchanged before clothing composition; no whole-body warp or generated hands, legs, hair, head or camera is adopted.
reproduction: Run tools/island_avatar/build_garment_layers.py with a fresh absolute --profile parent and the pinned Godot engine. --verify-live-fallback checks production originals without registering the candidate.
native_scope: Private 2D authoring viewport, fixed eight-fps preview timeline, time_scale 1 and 0.25. Not ParkWorld traveled-distance walk timing, wardrobe input, hair spring, reduced motion, packaged output, human play or audio listening.
visual_review: All 16 final normal/quarter viewport poses and joint diagram viewed. Both silent movies fully decoded; no claim of continuous video viewing.
snapshot_scope: Current rebake compiled PNGs equal the earlier reviewed PNGs byte for byte; script equality is checked after final runs, not retroactively claimed at launch of rejected attempts.
